title: Standing context document frontmatter v1alpha1
description: Frontmatter contract for a standing-context document: the single always-on file an agent loads at session start for a given workspace. The document declares its own instance rules here, so the validator that checks it needs no knowledge of the machine it runs on and can be carried anywhere.

kind.description: Discriminator. Identifies the document as an instance of this type.

schema.description: The contract this document claims to satisfy. A validator resolves its rules from here rather than assuming them.

knowledge-base.description: Canonical address of the knowledge base this document routes to. A URL, so it resolves from any working directory on any host.

forbids.description: Terms that must not appear in the document body. These are the couplings this instance has ruled out of scope; naming them here is what lets the check be enforced without being hardcoded into the tool.

required-sections.description: Level-two headings that must be present, matched on their leading text. Defaults are applied when absent; naming them lets an instance require more than the minimum, never less.

max-bytes.description: Upper bound on the document size. A standing-context file is read every turn, so unbounded growth is a defect rather than a preference.
